newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains lower on dull market.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains lower on dull market.

text.p: UK physical grains were one to two stg a tonne lower on Monday in trading that was subdued by a holiday in much of Europe.
"With futures coming down on currency, the market should be roaring away, but noone is interested," said a broker.
Brokers on the fob market reported no trading and said it was difficult to even get markets owing to the Whitsun holiday.
On the delivered market brokers reported just a few odd trades.
"It's been very hard work just finding someone to do business with," said another broker.
Delivered market milling wheat was trading in the Midlands from 113.50 down to 111 stg a tonne for June.
In East Anglia feed wheat fetched 90.50 and 90.25 stg for Jun while new crop in the Avon range traded at 96 stg for Oct/Dec.
